title: Vestigian — infrastructure
description: Host, containers, Postgres, Valkey and the Node process.

panels.title: Fullest disk
panels.description: Read-only mounts are excluded — they always report 100% used.

targets.expr: max(1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay|squashfs|ramfs|devtmpfs|erofs|iso9660"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay|squashfs|ramfs|devtmpfs|erofs|iso9660"} and on (instance, device, mountpoint) node_filesystem_readonly == 0)

panels.title: Network throughput
panels.description: Out is drawn below zero. Virtual and bridge interfaces are excluded.

panels.title: Filesystem used
panels.description: Prometheus, Loki, Tempo and the nightly dumps all write to this disk.

panels.title: CPU by container
panels.description: In cores: 1.0 is one full core.

panels.title: Restarts in range
panels.description: A container that keeps restarting looks healthy at every individual scrape.

panels.title: Buffer cache hit
panels.description: Below ~95% the working set no longer fits in shared buffers + page cache.

panels.title: Rows per second
panels.description: Scanned far above fetched means queries are reading rows they then discard.

panels.title: Temp files and conflicts
panels.description: Temp files mean a sort or hash spilled out of work_mem.

panels.title: Sequential scans by table
panels.description: The tile queries must use the GiST index; a sequential scan on `sites` is the regression to catch.

panels.title: Evictions (range)
panels.description: Evicted tiles and rate-limit counters. Non-zero means maxmemory is too small.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: One Node process is one core: sustained 1.0 is saturation.
